description: This file defines a data class for query parameters related to NewsResource filtering and an interface for a NewsRepository that provides access to news resources in a data layer, within an Android app using Kotlin and coroutines.

classes.name: NewsResourceQuery
classes.description: Encapsulates filter parameters for querying news resources, including optional topic and news IDs.

methods.name: getNewsResources
methods.description: Retrieves a flow of a list of news resources that match the given query parameters.
